description: Put saved tests in a suite or take them out. A test can be in several suites; taking it out of one does not delete it. Use list_tests to find the ids, and list_suites for the suite.

add.description: Saved test ids to put in the suite.
add.title: Add

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

remove.description: Saved test ids to take out of it.
remove.title: Remove

suite.description: The suite's id or name, as list_suites shows it. 'core' is the Core suite.
suite.title: Suite

name: change_suite_tests
